sponsored.t: Enacts Firefighter Joseph P. Spor Jr.'s Law requiring the establishment of September eleventh awareness curriculum or instruction for school districts
sponsored.sum: Enacts Firefighter Joseph P. Spor Jr.'s Law; requires the commissioner of education to establish September eleventh awareness curriculum or instruction for school districts; requires the education department to make curriculum materials and other resources regarding September eleventh available on its website.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the county of Putnam to lease certain lands used as parklands
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the county of Putnam to lease certain lands used as parklands in the town of Carmel for use as a cell tower for thirty years.

sponsored.t: Adds Lake Oscawana and Roaring Brook Lake in Putnam county to the definition of inland waterways
sponsored.sum: Adds Lake Oscawana and Roaring Brook Lake in Putnam county to the definition of inland waterways.

sponsored.t: Permits the town of Southeast, Putnam county, to lease certain sports field fences for advertisements
sponsored.sum: Permits the town of Southeast, Putnam county, to lease fences at the John E. Markel Memorial Park for advertisements.

sponsored.t: Relates to demonstration programs imposing monetary liability on the owner of a vehicle for failure of an operator thereof to comply with certain posted maximum speed limits in the town of Yorktown
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the town of Yorktown, Westchester county, shall have the ability to install and operate photo speed violation monitoring systems within construction or maintenance work areas that fall within the border or jurisdiction of such municipality; makes related provisions.

sponsored.t: Authorizes Breanne M. Smith to receive a refund of certain accumulated contributions paid to the New York state and local employees' retirement system
sponsored.sum: Authorizes Breanne M. Smith to receive a refund of certain accumulated contributions paid to the New York state and local employees' retirement system.

sponsored.t: Establishes the Birch Hill-Highview Water District in the town of Southeast, Putnam County
sponsored.sum: Establishes the Birch Hill - Highview Water District in the town of Southeast, Putnam County.

sponsored.t: Authorizes Mike Hartnett to apply for military service credit in the New York city fire pension fund
sponsored.sum: Authorizes Mike Hartnett to apply for military service credit in the New York city fire pension fund for active duty service in the U.S. Army from July 7, 1964 until July 7, 1967.

sponsored.t: Deems certain nominating or designating petitions to be permeated with fraud and invalidating the filings made by a contested candidate
sponsored.sum: Deems certain nominating or designating petitions to be permeated with fraud; invalidates the filings made by a contested candidate.

sponsored.t: Authorizes Tina Russo to receive certain service credit with the New York state teachers' retirement system
sponsored.sum: Authorizes Tina Russo to receive certain service credit with the New York state teachers' retirement system.

sponsored.t: Provides for the issuance of birth certificates of a deceased parent to their child
sponsored.sum: Provides for the issuance of birth certificates of a deceased parent to their child.

sponsored.t: Grants retroactive tier V membership in the New York state and local employees' retirement system to Marca McClenon
sponsored.sum: Grants retroactive tier V membership in the New York state and local employees' retirement system to Marca McClenon.

sponsored.t: Establishes Nicole's law, which provides for treatment of individuals with self-inflicted, life-threatening injuries
sponsored.sum: Establishes Nicole's law, which provides for intake and discharge procedures regarding individuals with self-inflicted, life-threatening injuries.

sponsored.t: Allows only citizens to vote at elections
sponsored.sum: Allows only citizens to vote at elections.

sponsored.t: Separates interscholastic athletic championships between public and non-public schools
sponsored.sum: Separates interscholastic athletic championships between public and non-public schools.

sponsored.t: Removes public officials for executing warrants from the international criminal court
sponsored.sum: Removes public officials for executing warrants from the international criminal court.

sponsored.t: Relates to requiring the notification of a public utility company's or municipality's customers when the supply rate increases by at least forty percent and to notify such customers of bill assistance
sponsored.sum: Requires the notification of a public utility company's or municipality's customers when the supply rate increases by at least forty percent and to notify such customers of bill assistance programs by posting on the utility company's website.

sponsored.t: Establishes the "Purple Star School Program" to assist military-connected students and to recognize the value of military service and civic responsibility
sponsored.sum: Establishes the "Purple Star School Program" to assist military-connected students and to recognize the value of military service and civic responsibility.

sponsored.t: Expands the veterans tuition awards program
sponsored.sum: Expands the veterans tuition awards program to include all persons who were honorably discharged and were residents of the state before and after serving in the armed forces of the United States; provides veterans an award equal to the in-state tuition paid at a state university for each semester the veteran is engaged in undergraduate, graduate or vocational study.

sponsored.t: Requires child day care centers, family day care homes, and any child day care provider notify the municipality in which they intend to operate of their intent to request such a license or registration
sponsored.sum: Requires child day care centers, family day care homes, and any child day care provider notify the municipality in which they intend to operate of their intent to request such a license or registration provided such child day care center, family day care home, or child day care provider is located within a city with a population of one million or more.

sponsored.t: Enacts "Jessica Lunsford act" relating to enhancing the class A-II felony of predatory sexual assault against a child
sponsored.sum: Enacts "Jessica Lunsford act" relating to enhancing the class A-II felony of predatory sexual assault against a child by expanding the acts to which such offense applies; establishes a mandatory sentence of 25 years to life term of imprisonment; requires electronic monitoring of incarcerated individuals upon release from prison.

sponsored.t: Requires local child protective services to notify appropriate military personnel when a member of the armed forces is the subject of a report of child abuse or maltreatment
sponsored.sum: Requires local child protective services to notify appropriate military personnel when a member of the armed forces is the subject of a report of child abuse or maltreatment; allows military law enforcement personnel to inquire of local child protective services whether any member of the armed forces is the subject of an indicated report on file with the statewide central register of child abuse and maltreatment.

sponsored.t: Establishes July sixteenth of each year as a day of commemoration known as "Atomic and Nuclear Veterans Day"
sponsored.sum: Establishes July sixteenth of each year as a day of commemoration known as "Atomic and Nuclear Veterans Day".

sponsored.t: Prohibits the acquisition of real property by foreign countries and entities of particular concern
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the acquisition of real property by foreign countries and entities of particular concern as well as citizens, companies, entities, and members of such countries and entities.

sponsored.t: Allows withdrawals from family tuition accounts to pay for treatment of substance use disorder for the designated beneficiary
sponsored.sum: Allows withdrawals from family tuition accounts to pay for treatment of substance use disorder, including detoxification and rehabilitation for the designated beneficiary.

sponsored.t: Requires a sentence of life imprisonment without parole for murder in the first degree, aggravated murder, and murder in the second degree
sponsored.sum: Requires a sentence of life imprisonment without parole for murder in the first degree, aggravated murder, and murder in the second degree.

sponsored.t: Requires a valid government issued photo identification card to be presented when casting a ballot
sponsored.sum: Requires a New York state driver's license or non-driver ID, a United States passport, an identification card issued by a United States educational institution, a United States military identification card, a government issued medical card, or any identification card issued by the United States or the state of New York to be presented when casting a ballot.

sponsored.t: Relates to making contractors and subcontractors that have been debarred under the Davis-Bacon Act (40 U.S.C. 3144) ineligible to bid for or be awarded public works contracts
sponsored.sum: Relates to making contractors, subcontractors, and substantially owned-affiliated entities that have been debarred under the Davis-Bacon Act (40 U.S.C. 3144) ineligible to bid for or be awarded public works contracts.

sponsored.t: Requires the approval of the legislature for certain proposed rule changes
sponsored.sum: Requires the approval of the legislature for certain proposed rule changes relating to civil or criminal penalties, fiscal liability or responsibility, costs due by state residents, and changes to education curriculum.

sponsored.t: Includes retirement plans in the exemption for pensions and annuities for certain persons and increases such exemption
sponsored.sum: Includes retirement plans in the exemption for pensions and annuities for certain persons; increases such exemption to one hundred thousand dollars as adjusted by the consumer price index annually.

sponsored.t: Provides a tax exemption for property operating as a child day care
sponsored.sum: Provides an optional tax exemption for property operating as a child day care that localities can opt into through local law.

sponsored.t: Establishes the crime of criminal sale of a controlled substance resulting in death
sponsored.sum: Establishes the crime of criminal sale of a controlled substance resulting in death, a class A-1 felony.

sponsored.t: Requires public hearings on increases in utility charges
sponsored.sum: Requires the public service commission hold public hearings on increases in utility rates, fees, rentals, or charges.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the legislative commission on the development of rural resources to study the effectiveness of pond and lake management programs
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the legislative commission on the development of rural resources to study the effectiveness of pond and lake management programs; provides for the comprehensive control and mitigation of harmful algal blooms in both marine and fresh water; provides for emergency response to water contaminations by algal bloom or hypoxia.

sponsored.t: Requires residents of the state, who are foreign refugees, to register with the office of temporary and disability assistance
sponsored.sum: Requires residents of the state, who are foreign refugees, to register with the office of temporary and disability assistance; directs such office to provide registration information to the office of children and family services, the department of health, the office for new Americans, the department of law, the division of state police, the NYC police department, county sheriff's offices, municipal police departments, and the division of homeland security and emergency services; directs the office for new Americans to conduct background screenings of all refugees who register; requires refugee resettlement agencies to submit quarterly reports to the bureau of refugee and immigrant…

sponsored.t: Directs the office of children and family services to develop a list of eligible substitute day care staff
sponsored.sum: Directs the office of children and family services to develop and post a list of eligible substitute day care staff who can be used by a child day care provider in a time of need.

sponsored.t: Provides that any special act school districts be held harmless from any reduction in tuition revenue or any tuition rate calculation and/or rate reconciliation
sponsored.sum: Provides that any special act school districts established pursuant to Chapter 566 of the Laws of 1967 shall be held harmless from any reduction in tuition revenue or any tuition rate calculation and/or rate reconciliation arising out of intake closure or limits on the entry of new student placements.

sponsored.t: Adds impersonation of board of elections members or other election officers to the crime of criminal impersonation in the first degree
sponsored.sum: Adds impersonation of board of elections members or other election officers, or an employee thereof, to the crime of criminal impersonation in the first degree.

sponsored.t: Defines antisemitism for purposes of the education law
sponsored.sum: Defines antisemitism for purposes of certain reviews of practices by the department of education.

sponsored.t: Requires the office of renewable energy siting to develop standards and conditions for the siting of certain large scale renewable energy systems
sponsored.sum: Requires the office of renewable energy siting to develop standards and conditions for the siting of certain large scale renewable energy systems; requires approval of municipalities to such siting plans.

sponsored.t: Establishes the crime of making a terroristic threat against a police officer
sponsored.sum: Establishes the crime of making a terroristic threat against a police officer; makes such crime a class C felony.

sponsored.t: Requires employers contracted for work on certain state-funded projects verify employment eligibility of employees
sponsored.sum: Requires employers contracted for work on state-funded public works projects verify employment eligibility of employees.

sponsored.t: Relates to the issuance of a New York State Cold War Commemorative Medal
sponsored.sum: Relates to the issuance of a New York State Cold War Commemorative Medal.

sponsored.t: Relates to verification of voter qualifications
sponsored.sum: Requires the state board of elections to participate in the systematic alien verification for entitlements (SAVE) program, administered by the United States citizenship and immigration services agency, to verify that a person who is either registered or registering to vote is a United States citizen.

sponsored.t: Creates a certified recovery residences task force
sponsored.sum: Creates a certified recovery residences task force to establish best practice guidelines for certified recovery living residences that illustrate the most appropriate and effective environment for persons recovering from a chemical dependency.

sponsored.t: Permits certain persons to leave behind opioid antagonists at the location of a known or suspected opioid overdose
sponsored.sum: Permits certain persons to leave behind opioid antagonists at the location of a known or suspected opioid overdose.

sponsored.t: Directs the commissioner of the office of children and family services to establish a consumer directed childcare pilot program in certain counties
sponsored.sum: Directs the commissioner of the office of children and family services to establish a Consumer Directed Childcare Pilot Program for eligible families, within amounts appropriated therefor, in up to five counties with populations between 160,000 and 300,000.

sponsored.t: Establishes a municipal senior center capital support program in the office for the aging for local senior centers to assist municipalities in accessing capital funds necessary for the purchase of senior buses
sponsored.sum: Establishes a municipal senior center capital support program in the office for the aging to assist municipalities in accessing capital funds necessary for the purchase of senior buses; directs the director of the office for the aging to develop an application and establish criteria for the disbursement of grants to eligible municipalities for the purpose of procuring senior buses; makes an appropriation.

sponsored.t: Requires a sentence of life imprisonment without parole for murder in the first degree, aggravated murder, and murder in the second degree
sponsored.sum: Requires a sentence of life imprisonment without parole for murder in the first degree involving the killing of a first responder.

sponsored.t: Enacts the safe housing transfer for domestic violence victims act
sponsored.sum: Enacts the safe housing transfer for domestic violence victims act; ensuring safe housing transfers for domestic violence victims in private and public housing.

sponsored.t: Establishes the digital government modernization initiative and the digital government enhancements pilot program
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "New York State Digital Government Modernization Act"; establishes the digital government modernization initiative and the digital government enhancements pilot program.

sponsored.t: Relates to child care assistance program postcards
sponsored.sum: Relates to the provision of child care assistance program postcards.

sponsored.t: Relates to the list of duties of the OCFS office of the ombudsperson
sponsored.sum: Adds to the list of duties of the OCFS office of the ombudsperson relating to hearing grievances and complaints.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the state board of elections and local boards of elections from accepting donations of private funds for election administration
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the state board of elections and local boards of elections from accepting donations of private funds for election administration.

sponsored.t: Relates to prohibited contributions by hostile foreign nations in connection with a state or local election
sponsored.sum: Prohibits contributions or donations to be made by hostile foreign nations in connection with a state or local election; makes a knowing violation of such provisions a class A felony, subject to an additional civil penalty equal to the contribution or donation amount plus a fine of up to ten thousand dollars.

sponsored.t: Authorizes early voting sites to be placed at at least one city in a county, or if there is no city in such county, the county seat
sponsored.sum: Authorizes early voting sites to be placed at at least one city in a county, or if there is no city in such county, the county seat.

sponsored.t: Requires persons appointed as election commissioners to be citizens of the United States
sponsored.sum: Requires persons appointed as election commissioners to be citizens of the United States.

sponsored.t: Establishes the commission to investigate foreign influence on governmental employees and elections
sponsored.sum: Establishes the commission to investigate foreign influence on governmental employees and elections.

sponsored.t: Limits the substitution of abuse-deterrent analgesic opioid drug products for analgesic opioids lacking such technology
sponsored.sum: Provides for patient access to FDA approved abuse-deterrent technology to help combat opioid abuse.

sponsored.t: Authorizes Angela Kilkenny Tier IV status in the New York state and local employees' retirement system
sponsored.sum: Authorizes Angela Kilkenny Tier IV status in the New York state and local employees' retirement system.

sponsored.t: Increases penalties for indecent exposure and public sexual activities occurring within public and association libraries
sponsored.sum: Increases penalties for indecent exposure and public sexual activities occurring within public and association libraries.

sponsored.t: Authorizes Larry Mendel to receive his 30 years of service credit granting eligibility for the length of service award program
sponsored.sum: Authorizes Larry Mendel to receive his 30 years of service credit granting eligibility for the length of service award program.

sponsored.t: Renames the veterans' services law the veterans and military families law and renames the department of veterans' services the department of veterans and military families
sponsored.sum: Renames the veterans' services law the veterans and military families law; renames the department of veterans' services the department of veterans and military families; requires the department of veterans and military families to provide certain services to military families.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "workforce development consolidation act of 2025" which transfers the office of strategic workforce development from the department of economic development to the department of labor; repealer
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "workforce development consolidation act" which transfers the office of strategic workforce development from the department of economic development to the department of labor; repeals provisions relating to such transfer.

sponsored.t: Establishes the New York State Servicemember Right-to-Repair Act
sponsored.sum: Establishes a right-to-repair for military property by requiring the adjutant general procure goods and services with fair and reasonable access to repair materials.

sponsored.t: Establishing a waiver program allowing for longer stays at domestic violence shelters
sponsored.sum: Establishes a waiver program allowing a domestic violence residential program to apply to the office of children and family services for a waiver enabling a victim of domestic violence to remain at the program's shelter for a period exceeding one hundred and eighty days.

sponsored.t: Removes the preclearance requirement from certain counties
sponsored.sum: Removes the preclearance requirement from certain counties regarding covered policies regarding elections.

sponsored.t: Establishes a tax deduction for tires that are blown out from potholes on state and local roads
sponsored.sum: Establishes a tax credit for tires that are blown out from potholes on state and local roads up to one thousand dollars.

sponsored.t: Enacts the Northeast Regional Health Insurance Compact Act
sponsored.sum: Enacts the Northeast Regional Health Insurance Compact Act directing the governor to invite the governors of Connecticut, Massachusetts, New Hampshire, Rhode Island, Vermont, Maine, New Jersey, and Pennsylvania to participate in a Northeast Regional Health Insurance Compact Summit along with their respective health and insurance regulators, to discuss the feasibility of creating a Regional Health Insurance Collaborative that allows residents of participating states to purchase qualified health insurance plans offered in any member state.

sponsored.t: Strengthens transparency regarding Medicaid network adequacy and protecting beneficiaries from disruptions in care
sponsored.sum: Ensures Medicaid spending results in real access to medical care by increasing transparency in Medicaid managed care network adequacy reviews and safeguarding continuity of care in light of recent major provider network withdrawals.

sponsored.t: Exempts retail food stores from various state and local taxes
sponsored.sum: Exempts retail food stores from various state and local taxes provided such store derives at least seventy percent of its annual gross sales from staple foods and food products for off-premises consumption.

sponsored.t: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system to Jake Arcara
sponsored.sum: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system in the town of Yorktown, county of Westchester, to Jake Arcara.

sponsored.t: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system to Westchester Purple Heart Recipients
sponsored.sum: Dedicates a portion of the state and local highway system constituting route thirty-five to Westchester Purple Heart Recipients.

sponsored.t: Extends the authorization to have an occupancy tax in the town of Putnam Valley, in the county of Putnam
sponsored.sum: Extends the authorization to have an occupancy tax in the town of Putnam Valley, in the county of Putnam.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the town of Patterson to impose a hotel and motel tax
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the town of Patterson, in the county of Putnam, to impose a hotel and motel tax.

sponsored.t: Extends the one percent increased county sales tax for Putnam county
sponsored.sum: Extends the one percent increased county sales tax for Putnam county for two years; requires one-ninth of such one percent increase in sales tax be allocated to towns and villages in such county.

sponsored.t: Waives the residency requirement for the office of commissioner of finance of the county of Putnam
sponsored.sum: Waives the residency requirement for the office of commissioner of finance of the county of Putnam.

sponsored.t: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system to John F. McArdle
sponsored.sum: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system constituting state route three hundred one from Belden Road to Gipsy Trail Road in the town of Carmel, county of Putman, to John F. McArdle.

sponsored.t: Waives the residency requirement for the office of Putnam county attorney
sponsored.sum: Waives the residency requirement for the office of Putnam county attorney.

sponsored.t: Requires the forfeiture of benefits to be paid pursuant to a service awards program to volunteer firefighters who have been convicted of certain crimes
sponsored.sum: Requires the forfeiture of benefits to be paid pursuant to a service awards program to volunteer firefighters who have been convicted of felonies committed against a volunteer fire department, volunteer fire company, fire district, or fire protection district.

sponsored.t: Allows for SNAP benefits to be used to purchase menstrual products
sponsored.sum: Allows for SNAP benefits to be used to purchase menstrual products.

sponsored.t: Authorizes bail for principals charged with aggravated cruelty to animals
sponsored.sum: Authorizes bail for principals charged with aggravated cruelty to animals.
